name: [Ψ]Intensify Flames
description:
Manipulate an existing fire, increasing its heat.  This can turn small flames into raging conflagrations or spread fire through the area.  If used on a target that is on fire, the increased flames will cause additional damage.

Level 5 leads to Molten Land.
Level 6 leads to Quell Fire with Banked Flames 5.
Level 8 leads to Thermogenesis with Banked Flames 10 + Brilliant Flash 7 OR Banked Flames 10 + Intensify Flames 8 OR Brilliant Flash 7 + Cloak of Warmth 6 OR Cloak of Warmth 6 + Intensify Flames 8.

name: [Ψ]Molten Land
description:
You reach into the ground and unmake it, pouring your will into the stone until it runs like water.  A single tile of <color_light_green>ground</color> -- soil, sand, rock, pavement, flooring, or the low growth on top of it -- becomes a pool of <color_red>molten lava</color>.

<color_yellow>This does not touch walls, doors, windows or fences.</color>  It melts the land, not what is built on it.

<color_red>The lava is permanent.</color>  It will not cool, and anything that steps into it is grievously burned.  Be certain before you unmake the floor you are standing near.

Level 4 leads to Banked Flames.
Level 7 leads to Blazing Aura with Cloak of Warmth 8 + Molten Land 7 + Thermogenesis 5 OR Cloak of Warmth 8 + Flamethrower 6 + Molten Land 7.
Level 6 leads to Cauterize with Incandescent Lance 5 OR Molten Land 6 + Quell Fire 6.
Level 6 leads to Cloak of Warmth with Banked Flames 6 OR Molten Land 6.
Level 13 leads to Conflagration with Flamethrower 8 + Thermogenesis 6 OR Blazing Aura 6 + Flamethrower 8 OR Molten Land 13 + Thermogenesis 6 OR Blazing Aura 6 + Molten Land 13.
Level 14 leads to Crucible with Conflagration 10 + Mass Hydrothermosis 6 + Molten Land 14 OR Conflagration 10 + Flamethrower 10 + Mass Hydrothermosis 6.
Level 9 leads to Incandescent Lance with Molten Land 9 + Quell Fire 6 OR Banked Flames 6.
message: The ground splits and runs molten!

name: [Ψ]Cauterize
description: Using an extremely focused application of pyrokinesis, sear a wound shut to stop the bleeding.  This is liable to be painful and is almost certainly likely to just cause more damage if you don't have any medical knowledge.  If the bleeding is too strong, cauterization will be ineffective, and there is a <color_red>chance of infection</color> whether you are successful or not.

name: [Ψ]Banked Flames (C)
description:
Call up flames over your outstretched hand.  You can use them to heat up food, boil water, start fires, or anything else fire can accomplish.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.  It is <color_red>canceled by engaging in combat</color>.

Level 6 leads to Cloak of Warmth with Banked Flames 6 OR Molten Land 6.
Level 7 leads to Flamethrower with Brilliant Flash 5.
Level 6 leads to Incandescent Lance with Molten Land 9 + Quell Fire 6 OR Banked Flames 6.
Level 5 leads to Quell Fire with Intensify Flames 6.
Level 10 leads to Thermogenesis with Banked Flames 10 + Brilliant Flash 7 OR Banked Flames 10 + Intensify Flames 8 OR Brilliant Flash 7 + Cloak of Warmth 6 OR Cloak of Warmth 6 + Intensify Flames 8.

name: [Ψ]Quell Fire
description:
As you can create fire, you can also unmake it.  You reach out and still the reaction itself, and the flames in the area simply <color_light_green>stop</color>.

This puts out <color_light_green>fires on the ground</color> across the target area, and any <color_light_green>flames on your own body</color> whether or not you are in that area.  It does not cool what has already been burned, and it will not touch lava.

Level 6 leads to Cauterize with Incandescent Lance 5 OR Molten Land 6 + Quell Fire 6.
Level 9 leads to Flameshield with Cloak of Warmth 10 + Quell Fire 9 OR Blazing Aura 6 + Quell Fire 9.
Level 6 leads to Incandescent Lance with Molten Land 9 + Quell Fire 6 OR Banked Flames 6.
